interpretation.source_storage: Gemma HF U8 INT2/INT4 weights use low-field-first offset-binary; INT8 weights use signed int8.
interpretation.tflite_storage: TFLite INT2/INT4 weights use low-field-first two's-complement packing; INT8 weights use signed int8.
interpretation.semantic_integer_match: decoded signed integer arrays are compared, so the distinct U8 versus TFLite signed sub-byte encodings are not falsely called a mismatch.
interpretation.scale_match: float32 arrays must compare exactly for a checkpoint-scale exact match.
interpretation.operator_scope: Weight-bearing FULLY_CONNECTED and EMBEDDING_LOOKUP operators plus QUANTIZE/DEQUANTIZE edges are recorded. Other arithmetic op types are counted in each graph histogram.

audit_notes: Source and TFLite signed integer payload hashes are compared after decoding the distinct Gemma offset-binary and TFLite two's-complement formats.
A source scale hash equal to a graph scale hash proves exact float32 per-axis scale equality; quantized_dimension and zero points are recorded for matched graph tensors.
Graph records are deduplicated by FlatBuffer buffer storage; source per-layer embedding tables are split into scale groups.
Operator histograms and DEQUANTIZE input qparam coverage are recorded per graph. Matched source tensor rows identify the unique graph buffer used by the weight-bearing graph.
